title: Later notes from S258 and S274 (wave 1 of v1.1)
lead: Follow-ups raised by the reviewers, UI passes and gates of S258 and S274. Each is unverified beyond the review that raised it; re-anchor before work. *Proposed.*
findings_note: S258 and S274 reviews and gates, 2026-11-07

sections.heading: Why
sections.body:
S258 (spec check rows):
- Quote the project name in the `no_spec_check_row` fix command: registry names are only checked for non-empty, so a name with a space gives a command that cannot be pasted (`internal/daemon/speccheck.go`).
- `roles.matrix` labels a non-reviewer row listed in `spec_check_rows` as a Spec check row, but the plan skips only reviewer-sourced rows and `specChain` reads only reviewer rows (`internal/daemon/matrix.go`, `runs.go`, `speccheck.go`).
- UI pass row versus `spec_check_rows`: the plan drops the listed row as a spec row before the UI check, the matrix still labels it UI pass row.
- A `spec_check_rows` setting that empties the reviewer chain returns a plain error that reaches the owner as `internal` (`internal/daemon/runs.go` near the chain build).
- Stale comments: `internal/registry/registry.go` (the `SpecCheckRows` field says unset means the row one rule names) and `internal/daemon/matrix.go` (`matrixUse` comment).
- S261 note: `spec_check_rows` stores per-project row ids; applying a shared matrix that renumbers rows must rewrite or flag them.

S274 (resume waits for a slot):
- `ork answer --wait` and `ork retry --wait` return at once when the resume is stored, before the rest wait.
- A failed registry read admits answer and retry on the last good file.
- The `t` refusal wraps with one word alone on the second line at 80 columns.
- The Running heard cell reads `wait 20m` from the pause, not from when the resume was queued.
- At 80x24 the pane hint loses `x stop`, the only action for a waiting run.
- An unselected waiting row has no cue beside `wait 20m`.
- A stop that cancels an answer already filed in adj replies `context canceled` and drops the filing notice; reply `run ID was stopped; answer filed in adj as #N`.
- The waiting-path adj filing runs under the request context, so a client disconnect could leave a key asked but not decided; consider the manager context.
- `engineRuns` reads the registry once per waiting run under the manager lock (cost only).
- Long refusal and status lines overflow 80 columns with real run ids (consistent with existing ones).

Environment:
- `internal/cli` `TestDoctorCheckCommandSyntaxError` fails on this Linux host (dash prints `Syntax error`) and on main; make it shell-neutral.
- The Codex implementer cannot run on this host (`/home/jon/.local/bin/codex-code-mode-host` missing).

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body: - One test per item above that changes behaviour; the implementer writes each red first.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body:
1. At start, re-anchor each item and drop any that a later slice already fixed.
2. Split the work into slivers only if the owner confirms.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- `go test ./...` with and without `-race`, `go vet ./...`, `gofmt -l .`, `slicer check`, `adj lint`.
- UI pass (rule u10) for the TUI items.

sections.heading: Git
sections.body: - Branch and worktree per AGENTS.md; no commit until the owner approves.
